canonicalFacts.claim: Colorectal cancer is the third most common cause of cancer mortality worldwide with over 1.85 million cases and 850,000 deaths annually
20% of colorectal cancer patients present with metastatic disease and another 25% with localized disease will later develop metastases
Among metastatic colorectal cancer patients, approximately 70-75% survive beyond 1 year, 30-35% beyond 3 years, and fewer than 20% beyond 5 years
Colorectal cancer incidence rates are highest in Alaska Natives and blacks, lowest in Asian/Pacific Islanders, and 30-40% higher in men than women
The global burden of colorectal cancer is expected to increase by 60% to more than 2.2 million new cases and 1.1 million deaths by 2030

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Aspirin may reduce colorectal cancer risk in high-risk populations such as Lynch syndrome patients
Address modifiable risk factors including smoking, low physical exercise, and obesity
Consider dietary modifications as unfavorable modern dietary habits contribute to increased colorectal cancer risk

redFlags: Metastatic colorectal cancer has poor long-term prognosis with fewer than 20% surviving beyond 5 years
Clinical symptoms often appear only in final stages, emphasizing importance of screening
High recurrence and metastasis rates despite multimodal treatment approaches

excludedAgents.name: Bevacizumab
excludedAgents.reason: Adding bevacizumab to cetuximab and irinotecan showed no improvement in progression-free survival in irinotecan-refractory metastatic colorectal cancer

excludedAgents.name: Probiotics
excludedAgents.reason: Six-month probiotic supplementation containing Lactobacillus and Bifidobacteria strains showed no significant clinical benefit in post-surgical colorectal cancer patients

excludedAgents.name: Shenbai Granules
excludedAgents.reason: Herbal medicine formula failed to significantly reduce recurrence of colorectal adenomas compared to placebo in randomized controlled trial

excludedAgents.name: Remote ischemic preconditioning
excludedAgents.reason: Failed to reduce incidence of prolonged post-operative ileus in patients undergoing laparoscopic colorectal cancer surgery

excludedAgents.name: Tranexamic acid
excludedAgents.reason: Did not reduce red blood cell transfusion requirements within 7 days of liver resection in cancer patients
